verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers flags, A/B and multivariate testing, targeting, bucketing, prerequisites and management APIs. Nothing documents defining experiment metrics from warehouse tables or ingested events. Mentions of data-driven decisions and group-level analysis do not describe user-defined metric sources, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store
